Database restore logic for sysvar cache entries from account records.

# Purpose
`fd_sysvar_cache_db.c` restores the sysvar cache from the account database stored in `funk`. It reads each sysvar account by public key, copies the account data into the cache, and then rebuilds the matching object cache entry with `fd_sysvar_obj_restore`. The helper [`sysvar_data_fill`](<#sysvar_data_fill>) handles one sysvar entry at a time, including missing-account handling, zero-balance filtering, and data size limits from the sysvar position table.

The file also provides two restore entry points. [`fd_sysvar_cache_restore`](<#fd_sysvar_cache_restore>) performs the restore with error logging, while [`fd_sysvar_cache_restore_fuzz`](<#fd_sysvar_cache_restore_fuzz>) runs the same logic without logging failures. Both functions create a writable sysvar cache view from the bank, iterate over all `FD_SYSVAR_CACHE_ENTRY_CNT` entries, and then release the cache view after the restore completes.
